{
  "subtype": "predictive_feature_engineering",
  "focus_variable": "resolution_minutes",
  "per_column": [
    {"name": "ticket_category", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Type of issue (bug, outage, feature_request) is knowable at intake and plausibly correlates with resolution time. Legitimate predictor."},
    {"name": "product_area", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Which product component the ticket concerns is available at intake and different areas plausibly have different resolution complexity."},
    {"name": "is_active_outage", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Whether an active outage is in progress is knowable at ticket creation and plausibly drives resolution duration."},
    {"name": "business_impact_type", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Nature of business impact is derivable from the ticket at intake and correlates with prioritization/effort. Legitimate signal."},
    {"name": "urgency_driver", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Stated urgency driver is available upfront and plausibly relates to how quickly/complexly a ticket is handled."},
    {"name": "root_cause_mechanism", "role": "leakage", "is_predictor": false, "rationale": "The root cause mechanism is typically only determined DURING or AFTER investigation/resolution. Knowing the true root cause is downstream of the diagnostic effort that consumes resolution time, so it leaks the outcome."},
    {"name": "is_regression", "role": "leakage", "is_predictor": false, "rationale": "Whether the issue was a regression is a diagnostic conclusion usually reached during resolution, not reliably knowable at intake. Post-hoc determination leaks resolution effort."},
    {"name": "affected_user_scope", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Scope of affected users can be characterized from the ticket at intake and plausibly predicts effort/priority. Legitimate predictor."},
    {"name": "involves_third_party_integration", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Whether a third-party integration is involved is inferable at intake and third-party dependencies plausibly lengthen resolution. Legitimate."},
    {"name": "involves_data_integrity_risk", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Data integrity risk is characterizable from the reported symptoms at intake and plausibly carries predictive signal on duration."},
    {"name": "has_security_or_compliance_dimension", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Security/compliance dimension is identifiable from the ticket at intake and plausibly affects handling time. Legitimate predictor."},
    {"name": "workaround_available", "role": "predictor", "is_predictor": true, "rationale": "Whether a workaround was mentioned by the customer is present in the intake description and plausibly relates to urgency/effort. Legitimate."}
  ],
  "n_predictors": 10,
  "predictive_utility": 0.7,
  "rationale": "Most added columns are intake-time attributes derived from the issue description that lie outside resolution_minutes and plausibly carry predictive signal (category, product area, outage status, impact, urgency, scope, integration/security/data-integrity flags, workaround). Two columns—root_cause_mechanism and is_regression—represent diagnostic conclusions typically established only during or after the resolution process and thus risk leaking the outcome. As a set the features provide substantial, genuine predictive leverage beyond the original columns, discounted for the leakage-prone diagnostic fields."
}
